## Target skill

`cross-disciplinary-social-science-manuscript-revision`

## Update type

- [ ] New research-design module
- [ ] New discipline adapter
- [ ] Existing audit rule correction
- [ ] Reporting-standard update
- [ ] Journal adapter
- [ ] Documentation / examples

## Problem

What manuscript-audit problem is currently missing or handled incorrectly?

## Trigger and scope

When should this update run, and what should it explicitly exclude?

## Evidence / method basis

What research design, methodological requirement, official reporting guidance, or primary methodological source supports the proposed change?

## Proposed audit rule

Describe the smallest rule or module that solves the problem.

## Claim boundary

What conclusions should become allowed, disallowed, or more qualified after this update?

## Interaction with existing modules

Which existing module(s) could overlap with this proposal?

## Example

Provide a realistic manuscript example showing the old behavior and the desired behavior.

## Version impact

- [ ] Patch — wording/bug fix only
- [ ] Minor — new module or meaningful routing change
- [ ] Major — changes top-level workflow or evidence-claim logic
